product_family: Visual academic paper discovery tool for researchers and scientists. Builds similarity graphs from academic papers using Semantic Scholar corpus. Single product with free and premium pricing tiers (Academic, Business, Group, Library).

certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 certification found on trust center, privacy policy, terms of service, or public pages.

certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 certification found on trust center, privacy policy, terms of service, or public pages.

certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27017 or ISO 27018 certification found on vendor domain.

certifications.proof_quote: You are granted full rights under GDPR, this includes: rights to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability

privacy.ai_training_note: Product is a search/discovery tool for existing academic papers. Does not appear to train on customer data. No generative AI features mentioned.
privacy.data_region: Microsoft Azure (location not specified, but Azure is global with regional options)

security.name: Data Storage Encryption
security.value: Data stored securely in Microsoft Azure

security.name: Payment Security
security.value: Handled by PayPro Global; checkout page hosted by PayPro for security; Connected Papers does not store credit card information

security.name: Analytics
security.value: Google Analytics used for tracking usage patterns and page views

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Account data (username, email, password) and saved papers retained. Mailing list email only for newsletter.

security.name: Third-Party Data Sharing
security.value: No marketing messages or sharing of data with third parties for marketing purposes

products.name: Connected Papers - Free Tier
products.data_scope: 5 Connected Papers graphs per month, saved papers, account data (email, username, password)
products.notes: Free tier with limited graphs. All features included but capped at 5 graphs monthly.

products.name: Connected Papers - Academic/Personal Plan
products.data_scope: Unlimited graphs, all features, for academics/non-profits and personal research use
products.notes: EUR 4.14/month annual billing (EUR 49.66/year). Premium tier with unlimited graphs. Academic use only.

products.name: Connected Papers - Business Plan
products.data_scope: Unlimited graphs, all features, for commercial and business use
products.notes: EUR 13.80/month annual billing (EUR 165.54/year). Premium tier for commercial entities.

products.name: Connected Papers - Group/Library Plans
products.data_scope: Team/organization access with seat-based licensing, single invoice, admin controls
products.notes: Available in Academic Group and Business Group variants. Academic Library variant with SSO, IP, email access for institutions.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with premium tiers. Free (5 graphs/month), Academic/Personal (EUR 4.14/month), Business (EUR 13.80/month), Group/Library plans with per-seat or per-org pricing.

flags: No formal security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) despite handling user account data and payment information.
Small company (2-10 employees) with limited security/compliance resources compared to enterprise vendors.
Terms of Service last updated 2023-02-21 (over 2.5 years ago); privacy/compliance documents may need refresh.
Payment handled by third-party (PayPro Global); Connected Papers does not store payment data directly. This reduces their PCI DSS responsibility but means payment security depends on vendor.
Uses Google Analytics for tracking; users should be aware of Google's data handling practices.
Governed by Israeli law; some users may have jurisdiction concerns.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) mentioned; GDPR-compliant but basic level of contractual data protection commitments.
